headline: How QQA Delivers 10% Yields From Tech Stocks That Pay Almost Nothing
summary: Nasdaq-100's biggest names pay next to nothing in dividends, yet one ETF built around them claims a near-10% monthly yield. The math behind that gap reveals a structure that most income investors have never seen before.
